##### 💛  - [Coveralls](https://coveralls.io)

The reason that the CI is failing the stable tutorials check is because of this line: https://github.com/Qiskit/qiskit-nature/blob/8e1da0a3d59dfd17c1741e6f1cdf90903b0c57ae/.github/workflows/main.yml#L341

The CI recursively removes the new tutorials and places the downloaded stable tutorials in their place. This breaks CI, because the `docs/migration` notebooks are trying to link to tutorial pages which no longer exist (because of the recursive deletion).

We have two options for fixing this:
1. we can also `rm -rf docs/migration/*` in this CI step
2. instead of `rm -rf docs/tutorials/*` we simply overwrite the new with the stable ones, leaving new files which did not exist before unchanged (i.e. only do the `cp -R ...` step

@manoelmarques what do you think?
